expected_diagnosis: Guest did not complete graceful ACPI shutdown.
recommended_next_checks: Check guest console, system logs, active writes, backup jobs.
resolution_guidance: Escalate for controlled shutdown; do not force power-off without approval.
verification: VM transitions cleanly without data corruption.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
